hook: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft without any human help.
hooks: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft without any human help.
Four AI bots entered a random Minecraft world and killed the dragon.
Google says the agents ran for over 27 hours and 14 minutes.
what_happened: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents autonomously explored a random Minecraft world, coordinated tasks, and killed the Ender Dragon after 27 hours and 14 minutes.
why_it_matters: It proves agentic AI can beat complex games without purpose‑built training, suggesting broader autonomous AI possibilities.
caption: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents autonomously completed Minecraft, slaying the Ender Dragon after more than 27 hours of play. Minecraft or Fortnite?
alt_text: The carousel explains how four Gemini 4 Argon AI agents autonomously completed Minecraft, coordinating tasks and defeating the Ender Dragon.
